source: public/geo/county-polygons.json (Census-derived county polygons), state OK; interior points are inside the named county, line points are inside it within the polygon county-line band

Adair.reason: The only Adair parcel layer on ArcGIS Online (sfrank_TB 'Adair County Parcel Data', layer 12 AdairCo_SelectParcelData) covers a ~0.1-degree patch around Stilwell and returned nothing at any of 9 county-wide test points; the assessor's own viewer (mapview-adair.com, a MapView Online site per the Oklahoma 811 county-assessor list) is not an ArcGIS REST service we can read, and its host is not reachable from the build sandbox.

Alfalfa.reason: Searched 2026-10-19: no countywide parcel layer exists on ArcGIS Online (about 1,470 Oklahoma-extent items were title/extent searched and 1,041 services had every polygon layer probed), ArcGIS Hub, or the NSGIC portal, and web search found no county-published REST viewer; the county's assessor runs a tax-roll or vendor viewer that is not a queryable ArcGIS REST layer we can read.
